race.comment: SOMEWHERE (4) put in some huge runs at Sandown-Hillside earlier in the season, then was a fair fourth off a freshen up at Geelong last time out, which will have him spot on for this. He drops beautifully in weight, and is the one to beat for us. EL JAMES (6) is a very handy gelding when right, and he resumes from a spell with a couple of trials under his belt. Dean Yendall is in good form, and picks up the ride, so keep then very safe. Check the market. QUIETNESS (1) has recently changed stables, and has a jumping career ahead of her. She won a recent trial. Include. BULLETS HIGH (5) was much better third up at Geelong 8 days ago and he can hold his form when fit, so stick with him. FOX APPEAL (8) has been racing well all season, and even though he meets a deeper field here, he can still figure in the top 4, especially with the aid of the pole position.
